title: Red-team random draw is 95% ventures; CI and tooling code is almost never mutated
problem: redteam.py's default target draw is uniform over guarded files, so platform/ and portfolio/ (the code every run depends on) are rarely tested. A redteam friction report also said platform/ci files never appear in `targets`.
evidence: python3 -c 'redteam.list_targets()' by top directory, 2026-10-17: ventures 3502, platform 109, portfolio 52, prompts 4 (3667 total).
change: Add --under DIR to `redteam.py targets` and `campaign`, and mention it in the redteam prompt.
metric: share of recorded campaigns whose target is outside ventures/
baseline: not measured; expected about 5% from the draw
result: helped: red-team targets outside ventures/ were 11 of 84 (13%) in records dated 2026-10-15..17 and 12 of 14 (86%) in 2026-10-18 records (python over prompts/runs/*.json, redteam.campaigns[].target). Small n after the fix.
